## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_偏印 (Earth carrying The Alchemist). Persona The Alchemist (偏印). Definition line: "Unconventional nourishment, the insight that transmutes". Keyword Insight, charge fierce, poles catalyst Vision / friction Distance. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: nourishment that transmutes; fed on strange food, recipe unshareable. Arena: crucible, moon-side, distillation, the changed substance. Classical portrait: unorthodox absorption; solitary mastery; intake that starves output (枭神夺食). Ruled domains: Learning, Intuition, Solitude. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正印.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Earth generating Metal same-polarity — stability as quiet source of precision".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth carries the Alchemist’s current: nourishment that arrives as understanding rather than comfort. This is ground that reads before it feeds, soil that turns experience over slowly until it becomes insight. It shelters you the way a library shelters, quiet, stocked, slightly apart, and it asks one rent: time alone to do the turning."
- k2_functional: "Thinking runs deep and sideways. You digest slowly, connect strangely, and surface with conclusions no straight line could have reached."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Withdrawn","Brooding","Overprepared"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Learning":"Learning is where this Earth feeds you best. Not the classroom kind so much as the deep private kind: the obsession studied at midnight, the field entered through the side door. Give it one strange subject at a time. What you learn that way tends to outlast anything you learned for a grade.","Intuition":"The hunch arrives before the reason does, and for you it is usually load-bearing. Treat the sudden knowing as a first draft: trust it enough to write it down, doubt it enough to check the math by morning.","Solitude":"Time alone is this energy’s rent, and it collects whether you schedule it or not. Taken on purpose, solitude turns into your best material. Taken by accident, it curdles into distance from the people who were waiting outside the study."}

Panicked friends arrive spinning and leave walking. You ask the slow questions, name the one thing that is actually true, and the drama finds it has nowhere to plug in."

Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Earth on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Earth as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. value.text: Learning a thing your own way matters more to you than the approved way. Since you need to understand before you trust, you take the side door into a subject rather than the front one. Let someone walk that route with you sometimes, because a way only you know is lonely to own.

value_b.text: You would rather work a thing out alone than be shown it. Needing to understand from the inside makes you learn slowly, which puts the private lesson ahead of the shared one. Try saying what you found out loud once in a while, because knowledge you never explain stays yours alone.

value.text: The hunch reaches you before the reason does, and you take it seriously. Because you need to know a thing from underneath rather than from its surface, you read what lies under what is said. You cannot always explain it, so let the reason catch up before you act on it.

value_b.text: Knowing comes to you before understanding does, and you accept the order as it comes. value.text: You do your best thinking with no one else in the house. Being alone is where the taking in happens for you, so you want the quiet ahead of the company. You pay for it in company that thins out on its own, which is why one open evening a week is worth keeping.

value_b.text: Thinking alone comes more naturally to you than talking it out. Because you want the whole picture before saying any of it, you treat company as interruption rather than help until the thought is done. Say one thought out loud before it is finished, since you only get help on ones you let out early.

value.text: Whenever a day has held too many people, you need an hour with none to feel yourself. Time alone is how you fill back up rather than hide, which is why you guard it harder than your sleep. Guard the sleep too, since the quiet you take from the night was owed to the body.

value.text: Your quiet is a place you go without saying how long you will be. Because you think best out of reach, you let the hours alone run past what you promised rather than stop early. Name the length before you go, since you owe the people waiting a time to expect you.
